## pairwise log comparision


```{r}
theta <- fit_multinom$L
stopifnot(nrow(theta) == nrow(df))
N <- nrow(theta); K <- ncol(theta)

c0 <- 1e-4
med_k <- colMedians(theta, na.rm = TRUE)
eps_k <- c0 * med_k

# guardrails
eps_k <- pmin(pmax(eps_k, 1e-12), 1e-2)

theta01 <- pmin(pmax(theta, 0), 1)

# log(theta + eps_k) with sweep
log_theta <- log(sweep(theta01, 2, eps_k, FUN = "+"))   # N x K

```

```{r}
df <- droplevels(meta_balanced)
df$treatment  <- droplevels(factor(df$treatment))
df$dosage     <- droplevels(factor(df$dosage))
df$time       <- droplevels(factor(df$time))
df$cell_state <- droplevels(factor(df$cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP")))

df$cond_cs <- interaction(df$treatment, df$dosage, df$time, df$cell_state,
                          sep = "_", drop = TRUE)

df$cond_cs <- relevel(df$cond_cs, ref = "WT_0_0_G1")

design_cs <- model.matrix(~ cond_cs, data = df)
colnames(design_cs) <- make.names(colnames(design_cs))
stopifnot(limma::is.fullrank(design_cs))

```

## Build pairwise features
```{r}
pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))      # n_pairs x 2
n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)
for (p in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
  k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
  k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
  log_ratio_mat[, p] <- log_theta[, k1] - log_theta[, k2]
}

colnames(log_ratio_mat) <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
  paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2])
})

Y_lr <- t(log_ratio_mat)        # features x samples
dim(Y_lr)
dim(design_cs)
```

```{r}
fit_lr <- lmFit(Y_lr, design_cs)
fit_lr <- eBayes(fit_lr, robust = TRUE)

# coefficients of interest (all cond_cs levels except intercept)
coef_names <- colnames(fit_lr$coefficients)
cond_cs_coefs <- grep("^cond_cs", coef_names, value = TRUE)
cond_cs_coefs

```

```{r}
res_pairs_all
```

```{r}
res_pairs_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cond_cs_coefs, function(cf) {
  tt <- topTable(fit_lr, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  tt$coef <- cf
  tt$pair <- rownames(tt)          # correct feature id
  tt
}))

rownames(res_pairs_all) <- NULL    # IMPORTANT: drop mangled rownames

parse_pairs <- function(pair_vec) {
  parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(pair_vec, "_vs_"))
  k1 <- as.integer(sub("^T", "", parts[,1]))
  k2 <- as.integer(sub("^T", "", parts[,2]))
  data.frame(pair = pair_vec, k1 = k1, k2 = k2)
}

# pair_info <- parse_pairs(unique(res_pairs_all$pair))
pair_info <- parse_pairs(rownames(Y_lr))

# optional sanity check
stopifnot(!any(is.na(pair_info$k1)), !any(is.na(pair_info$k2)))
res_pairs_all
```

```{r}
res_long <- res_pairs_all %>%
  left_join(pair_info, by = "pair") %>%
  select(coef, pair, logFC, adj.P.Val, P.Value, k1, k2)


# expand each pair into two directed rows: (topic=k1, other=k2) and (topic=k2, other=k1)
res_directed <- bind_rows(
  res_long %>% transmute(coef, pair, topic = k1, other = k2,
                         beta =  logFC, q = adj.P.Val, p = P.Value),
  res_long %>% transmute(coef, pair, topic = k2, other = k1,
                         beta = -logFC, q = adj.P.Val, p = P.Value)
)

res_long 
```
## Least extreme effect size 
```{r}
alpha <- 0.05

least_extreme <- res_directed %>%
  group_by(coef, topic) %>%
  summarise(
    # Least-extreme EFFECT size: min_{other} |beta|
    S = min(abs(beta), na.rm = TRUE),

    # "Worst" q-value across comparisons (strict "all significant" check)
    Q_worst = max(q, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Fraction of pairwise comparisons significant for this topic
    frac_sig = mean(q < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Which other topic achieved the minimum |beta| (helpful for interpretation)
    other_min = other[which.min(abs(beta))][1],
    beta_min  = beta[which.min(abs(beta))][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(topic = paste0("T", topic),
         other_min = paste0("T", other_min))

```

```{r}
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    time = as.numeric(time),
    dosage = factor(dosage),
    cell_state = factor(cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP"))
  ) %>%
  filter(treatment != "WT")   # <-- exclude WT


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# helper to extract topic index
plot_le2 <- plot_le %>%
  mutate(topic_id = as.integer(sub("^T", "", topic)))

make_plot_block <- function(lo, hi) {
  ggplot(
    plot_le2 %>% filter(topic_id >= lo, topic_id <= hi),
    aes(x = time, y = S, color = treatment, linetype = dosage)
  ) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_grid(cell_state ~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "Time",
      y = "Least-extreme |beta| = min over other topics",
      title = paste0("Topic distinctness over time (T", lo, "–T", hi, ")")
    )
}

p1 <- make_plot_block(1, 8)
p2 <- make_plot_block(9, 16)

p1
p2
# High S ⇒ topic k changes relative to every other topic (strong “topic distinctness” signal).

#Topic 15 is most distinct from all other topics under osimertinib (30) at time 100 in G1, but its distinctness diminishes over time
```

## fraction significant
```{r}
library(dplyr)

res_long2 <- res_long %>%
  group_by(coef) %>%
  mutate(q_pair = p.adjust(P.Value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
res_long2
```


```{r}
res_directed <- bind_rows(
  res_long2 %>% transmute(coef, pair, topic = k1, other = k2,
                          beta =  logFC, p = P.Value, q = q_pair),
  res_long2 %>% transmute(coef, pair, topic = k2, other = k1,
                          beta = -logFC, p = P.Value, q = q_pair)
)
res_directed 
alpha <- 0.05

topic_summary <- res_directed %>%
  group_by(coef, topic) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total  = sum(!is.na(q)),
    n_sig    = sum(q < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_sig = n_sig / n_total,

    # optional: least-extreme effect size
    S        = min(abs(beta), na.rm = TRUE),
    other_min = other[which.min(abs(beta))][1],
    beta_min  = beta[which.min(abs(beta))][1],

    # optional: strict "all significant" style summary
    Q_worst  = max(q, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    topic = paste0("T", topic),
    other_min = paste0("T", other_min)
  )
topic_summary 
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_df2 <- topic_summary %>%
  mutate(coef_raw = sub("^cond_cs", "", coef)) %>%
  separate(coef_raw, into = c("treatment","dosage","time","cell_state"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(time, levels = sort(unique(as.numeric(time)))),
    dosage = factor(dosage, levels = c("10","20","30")),   # adjust if needed
    cell_state = factor(cell_state, levels = c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP"))
  ) %>%
  filter(treatment != "WT")

base_plot <- function(dat, ttl) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = time, y = topic, fill = frac_sig)) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(cell_state ~ treatment + dosage, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 7)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Time",
      y = "Topic",
      fill = "Fraction\nsignificant",
      title = ttl
    )
}

p_G1S <- base_plot(filter(plot_df2, cell_state %in% c("G1","S")),
                   "Fraction significant (G1, S)")

p_G2M <- base_plot(filter(plot_df2, cell_state %in% c("G2","M")),
                   "Fraction significant (G2, M)")

p_APOP <- base_plot(filter(plot_df2, cell_state %in% c("APOP")),
                    "Fraction significant (APOP)")

p_G1S
p_G2M
```

## plot beta

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

alpha <- 0.05
topic_k <- 15

plot_t3 <- res_directed %>%
  filter(topic == topic_k, other != topic_k) %>%
  mutate(coef_raw = sub("^cond_cs", "", coef)) %>%
  separate(coef_raw, into = c("treatment","dosage","time","cell_state"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    time = as.numeric(time),
    dosage = factor(dosage),
    cell_state = factor(cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP")),
    other_id = other,                              # keep numeric other for filtering
    other = paste0("T", other),                    # make label
    other = factor(other, levels = paste0("T", setdiff(1:K, topic_k))),
    topic = paste0("T", topic_k),
    sig = q < alpha
  ) %>%
  filter(treatment != "WT")

make_t3_plot <- function(dat, ttl) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = time, y = beta,
                  group = interaction(treatment, dosage),
                  color = treatment, linetype = dosage)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 1.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16)) +
    facet_grid(cell_state ~ other, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(5, 10, 30, 240, 1440)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Time",
      y = expression(beta[c]~~"for"~~log(theta[T3]+epsilon[3]) - log(theta[other]+epsilon[other])),
      shape = "BH < 0.05",
      title = ttl
    )
}

# Plot 1: others in T1–T8 (excluding T3)
p_1_8 <- make_t3_plot(
  filter(plot_t3, other_id %in% 1:8),
  "T3 vs other topics (T1–T8)"
)

# Plot 2: others in T9–T16
p_9_16 <- make_t3_plot(
  filter(plot_t3, other_id %in% 9:16),
  "T3 vs other topics (T9–T16)"
)

p_1_8
p_9_16

```

```{r}
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 1.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16)) +
    facet_grid(cell_state ~ other, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Time",
      y = expression(beta[c]~~"for"~~log(theta[T3]+epsilon[3]) - log(theta[other]+epsilon[other])),
      shape = "BH < 0.05",
      title = ttl
    )
}
```

```{r}
R <- residuals.MArrayLM(fit_lr, y = Y_lr)   # features x samples
dim(R)
Mu <- fitted.MArrayLM(fit_lr, y = Y_lr)     # features x samples
library(matrixStats)

R  <- residuals.MArrayLM(fit_lr, y = Y_lr)
Mu <- fitted.MArrayLM(fit_lr, y = Y_lr)

# 1) QQ plot for a few random features
set.seed(1)
feat_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(Y_lr)), 9)

# par(mfrow=c(3,3), mar=c(3,3,2,1))
for (j in feat_idx) {
  qqnorm(R[j, ], main=rownames(Y_lr)[j], cex=0.5)
  qqline(R[j, ], col="red")
}
par(mfrow=c(1,1))

# 2) residual variance vs fitted mean (feature-level)
m <- rowMeans(Mu)
v <- rowVars(R)

plot(m, v, pch=16, cex=0.35,
     xlab="feature mean(fitted)", ylab="feature var(residual)")

# 3) sample-level residual SD (spot outlier samples)
sample_rsd <- apply(R, 2, sd, na.rm=TRUE)
plot(sample_rsd, pch=16, cex=0.6,
     xlab="sample index", ylab="residual SD across features")
abline(h=quantile(sample_rsd, 0.99), lty=2, col="red")


```
